name: welcome_pupil
description: Sent to a new pupil's school e-mail address when their login is created.
subject: Welcome to {school_name}, {pupil_first_name}
body: Welcome to {school_name}! Your school account has been set up.
Keep your password to yourself - never share it with friends.
If you think someone else knows it, tell the school office and they will reset it.
If you have any problems signing in, please speak to your form tutor or the school office.

placeholders.pupil_first_name: The pupil's preferred or first name
placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.form_details: The pupil's form, form tutor (with e-mail) and form room, one per line
